query:
INSERT INTO threads_issue_facets (
                    id,
                    issue_id,
                    what,
                    verdict
                )
                SELECT facet_id, $1, what, verdict
                FROM UNNEST(
                    $2::int8[],
                    $3::jsonb[],
                    $4::varchar[]
                ) AS facet(facet_id, what, verdict)
